description: List the entities in a Graph knowledge base, highest-degree (most-connected) first — for browsing the graph or letting an agent discover what it can traverse. Optionally filter by entity type or a name substring. Wire a Knowledge Base node into knowledge_base, same as the search nodes.

inputs.name: knowledge_base
inputs.description: The knowledge base to list, from a Knowledge Base node. If omitted, falls back to the flow's default knowledge base.

inputs.name: type
inputs.description: Optional: only entities of this type (e.g. person, organization). Case-insensitive.

inputs.name: search
inputs.description: Optional: only entities whose name contains this text (case-insensitive).

inputs.name: limit
inputs.description: Maximum number of entities to return

outputs.name: entities
outputs.description: Entity rows (id, name, type, description, degree, …), most-connected first
